recentItems.title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds | Pike Has Cosmic Amnesia (S4, E7) | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
Captain Pike (Anson Mount) wakes up in sickbay where Doctor M’Benga (Babs Olusanmokun) and Nurse Chapel (Jess Bush) inform him he has amnesia from a shuttle crash, but Pike senses something very peculiar about his crew. Searching for answers, he reaches out to the ship’s counselor, Doctor Chivers (Deidre Hall). Little do they all know, they’re being watched by a mysterious being (Rhys Darby). Season 4, Episode 7: Like Chronitons Through the Hourglass

recentItems.title: Team Moms: Baseball | Official Trailer | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
Team Moms: Baseball premieres September 24 on Paramount+.

Team Moms: Baseball follows a group of parents whose sons attend Legendary Prep Academy: a premier baseball training school in Scottsdale, Arizona, dedicated to molding the next generation of star athletes. The boys battle for top spots on the field while their parents navigate family life, friendships and fierce competition all to make their sons’ dreams come true. As the season unfolds, rumors emerge that challenge loyalty and question sportsmanship on and off the field.

recentItems.title: Corporate | Trapped at the Office on Labor Day (S2, E7) | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
Stuck working on Labor Day, Matt (Matt Ingebretson), Jake (Jake Weisman), and Christian (Lance Reddick) learn an intruder is loose in the building. After a tense search leads to a terrifying encounter with a closet mop, the guys embrace their inner Scooby-Doo gang and hit the cafeteria to build absurdly massive sandwiches. Season 2 Episode 7: Labor Day
